name: pr-guardian
description: GitHub Action that checks pull requests against configurable quality rules and posts a review comment.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
